selection_disclosure: V1 showed no executable A/B marks because the nearest short-horizon Polymarket boundary generally preceded the listed option term. V2 was frozen before collection. It adds every strike only when the Polymarket boundary exactly equals an actually listed Deribit expiration and the Binance hourly-close rule is deterministically certified; it does not select assets, sides, strikes or events from PnL.

market_scope.baseline_targets: active numeric Polymarket threshold contracts with a recognized resolver feed
market_scope.exact_expiry_expansion: all strikes in a current threshold event when its UTC boundary equals a listed Deribit call expiration to the millisecond
market_scope.resolver_certification: requires an above predicate, two distinct tokens, explicit Binance BTC/USDT or ETH/USDT source, explicit Close price and explicit one-hour candle
market_scope.deribit_selection: calls at two strikes on each side of every target plus frozen ATM archive anchors, maximum 160 public subscriptions

valuation.model: cash digital under the bid/mark/ask Deribit volatility surface
valuation.strike_interpolation: linear in IV over log strike
valuation.resolver_basis: the live RTDS feed matching the contract rule, Binance for Binance-resolved contracts; Chainlink is never substituted
valuation.uncertainty: resolver-versus-Deribit index basis plus or minus 3 bps and the complete bid/ask IV interval
valuation.fees: current Polymarket fee metadata stressed at 2x; unknown fees fail closed
valuation.hedge: rounded spot/perpetual base quantity equal to negative model delta with 5 bps cost stress
valuation.residual_risk: binary gamma, IV and resolver-basis CVaR retained per observation

evaluation.multiple_testing: Holm correction across asset, side, target class, surface fidelity and latency profile
evaluation.capacity: displayed Polymarket depth and executable hedge depth only
evaluation.promotion: Passing permits only a separately reviewed tiny authenticated canary; this manifest grants no live authority.
evaluation.zero_edge_disclosure: No exact-expiry opportunities or zero/negative post-cost PnL is a valid result and cannot be repaired by retuning this cohort.
